title: 150 Days Without Sunrise, Frozen Into the Arctic
asof: Figures from the MOSAiC expedition 2019–2020 · full video on the channel

shots.s: Imagine the sun not rising for about a hundred and fifty days.
That's what the MOSAiC expedition lived through.
A ship frozen into the Arctic ice, drifting past the North Pole.
Only the moon and stars light the ice.
The coldest reading: minus forty-two point three.
With the wind, it felt like minus sixty-five.
The ice moves, and cracks open through the camp.
The nearest town is up to fifteen hundred kilometers away.
And when the sun came back, it didn't set all summer.
Could you handle five months of night?
